response.sql: SELECT rating, avg_ratio, films, avg_ratio - AVG(avg_ratio) OVER () AS diff_from_mean_of_ratings FROM (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS films FROM film GROUP BY rating) t ORDER BY rating

assumptions.assumption: The 'plain average of the five rating-level values' is the unweighted mean of the five per-rating average ratios, not weighted by film count and not the overall film-level average.
The film count is COUNT(*) of films in each rating. Rental_rate and replacement_cost are both NOT NULL, so every film has a ratio.
